name: Nice Côte d'Azur Airport

slots.v: fully coordinated (Level 3): all operations need a slot; business and general aviation slots are requested by the handling agent from the French slot coordinator (COHOR)
slots.quote: Aircraft operators contact their handling agent who is in charge to request airport slots to COHOR.

handling.v: business aviation handling limited to three providers: AviaVIP, Signature Aviation and DC Aviation G-OPS
handling.quote: The number of groundhandlers (FBO) is limited to three service providers.

noise.v: APU use limited to 30 minutes; engines fully shut down on arrival at the KILO parking area
noise.quote: APU use is limited to 30 minutes

runway.v: two parallel runways: 04R/22L, 2,963 m by 45 m (the longest), and 04L/22R, 2,628 m by 45 m

ppr.v: minimum handling is compulsory and must be arranged (PPR) before leaving the departure airport (VFR chart text)
ppr.quote: Minimum handling compulsory PPR before departure from origin AD.

curfew.v: night restriction for noisier jets only, not a full closure: jets not certified to ICAO Annex 16 Chapter 3 or 4, or Chapter 3 jets with a cumulative margin below 13 EPNdB, may not land 23:30-06:15 or take off 23:15-06:00 local (on-block/off-block times); exceptions for medical, humanitarian, safety, state and government flights; no engine tests 21:00-06:00
curfew.applies_to: jet aircraft not Chapter 3/4 certified, or Chapter 3 with cumulative margin below 13 EPNdB
curfew.quote: – atterrir entre 23 h 30 et 6 h 15, heures locales d’arrivée sur l’aire de stationnement ; – décoller entre 23 h 15 et 6 heures, heures locales de départ de l’aire de stationnement.

notes: French eAIP (SIA) and Légifrance (arrêté of 2 March 2010 on Nice night restrictions) could not be opened. Operator news item (12 Jan 2021) says the northern runway measures 2,420 m; southern runway length not stated, so longest runway not verified. The 'noise' and 'notable' quotes came back paraphrased by the fetch tool (e.g. 'APU use is limited to 30 minutes'); re-check exact wording. The handler licence text on the page dates from 2014-2022 and may be out of date. COHOR page last modified 2 Oct 2026. Do not name companies on the public site (site rule). | 2026-10-27 run: Current SIA eAIP HTML (01 OCT 2026) not openable; ARP, runways and night rule from AIP France AD 2 LFMN (AIRAC AMDT 06/25, 12 JUN 2025) as republished by DIRCAM; location, customs, PPR from the SIA VAC atlas, 01 OCT 2026 edition. The night rule is a ban on noisy aircraft classes only, not a full closure; times are stated in local time. VFR restriction times are UTC winter (SUM -1 HR = same local time, 11:00-14:00 local). Facts from the superseded edition other than runway, location and operator were not used (curfew). | 2026-10-30 run: Current SIA eAIP and VAC PDFs could not be opened (permission not granted for the URLs). Curfew added from the arrêté of 2 March 2010 (official text, copy published by COHOR); it bans landings 23:30-06:15 and take-offs 23:15-06:00 local only for jets without Chapter 3/4 certification or with a cumulative margin below 13 EPNdB (art. 1 II-IV, IV from 30 Oct 2011). windows_local is the union of both windows; check the aircraft's noise certificate rather than treating it as a closure. Amendments after 2010 could not be ruled out (Légifrance not opened). Status kept partial: runway still comes from the superseded AIP edition (AMDT 06/25). max_aircraft not found.
